name: Cocoa bean, roasted (~2% moisture)
source: Roasted whole bean: illustrative proximate (per kg) water 20 g (~2%), protein 135 g, fat 460 g, carbohydrate 345 g, ash 40 g — roasting drives off most of the bean's remaining moisture (cocoa science literature).
notes: Standard elemental conversion factors as wheat-grain.json. Roasting is modelled in origin/cocoa.ts as a further real moisture-loss step from cocoa-bean-dried's ~7% down to this file's ~2%, via the same water-removal technique agri/harvest.ts's dryGrain uses for grain drying.
